territories.name: Andorra
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Andorra levies an indirect tax of its own, the impost general indirecte, under Law 11/2012 of 21 June 2012 as amended: article 57 sets the general rate at 4.5 per cent, articles 58 and 59 the 1 and 0 per cent rates, article 60 the 9.5 per cent rate on banking and financial services, article 14 exempts exports, and article 78 has the taxable person file a monthly, quarterly or semi-annual declaration by the turnover of the year before.
